# Pixel Metronome

A tiny offline metronome built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No packages, no network requests, no external assets.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Everything works offline.

## Controls

- **− / +** buttons adjust the tempo between 40 and 200 BPM (1 BPM steps).
- **Start** begins the metronome and resets the beat counter to 0.
- **Stop** halts the metronome and resets the beat counter to 0.
- The **beat light** flashes on every tick.
- The **beat counter** increments on every tick while running.

Keyboard: **Space** toggles Start/Stop when the page body has focus. All buttons are real `<button>` elements and reachable with Tab; focus is shown with a visible outline.

## Behavior notes

- BPM is clamped to 40–200; the − and + buttons disable at the limits.
- Changing BPM while running reschedules the next tick immediately.
- Starting while already running is ignored; stopping while stopped is ignored.
- The beat light uses a short CSS transition and a per-tick timeout so rapid tempos do not leave the light stuck on.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and required element IDs
- `styles.css` — palette, layout, control states
- `app.js` — metronome logic

## Accessibility

- All controls have accessible names via `aria-label` or visible text.
- The BPM and beat counter are announced via `aria-live`.
- Layout works from 360px wide; controls wrap when needed.
